_comment: FACTORtv booth dialogue. Slots: {a} passer, {b} passed, {drv} subject,
{pos} position, {gap} gap text, {lap} lap number, {laps} laps left,
'needs'/'not' gate on era capabilities; 'era'/'disc' gate on period and
discipline; 'i' is intensity 0-3; 'who' overrides the persona.

start.t: Lights out, and away we go!
The flag drops, and they're away!
Clean getaway across the front row!
They stream down to turn one, {drv} leading the way!
Here we go then, {laps} laps of it!
A good start, and it's {drv} who has the run!
Everybody through turn one, and remarkably it's all clean!
The green flag is out at {trk}!
Twenty-odd cars funnelling into that first corner!

start_chaos.t: Oh, contact! Contact at the start!
That's gone wrong for somebody in the pack!
Somebody's been squeezed out at turn one!

overtake.t: Around the outside! That's brave from {a}!
{b} has no answer, and {a} is through!
{a} had the better exit and that was that.
Late on the brakes, and {a} is ahead!
{a} with the DRS, and it's an easy one on {b}.
The rear wing opens, and {a} sails past {b}.
{a} gets the run out of the draft and takes {b}!
A slipstream tow down the straight, and {a} is by!
Wheel to wheel, and it's {a} who comes out in front!
{a} has been all over {b} for two laps and finally makes it count.

overtake_multi.t: Two at once! {a} is having none of it!

leadchange.t: {a} takes the lead of the race!
{a} is through, and into the lead!
That is the move for the lead of the Grand Prix!
{a} leads, and {b} will have to regroup.

battle.t: {a} is right with {b} now, {gap} between them.
This is a proper scrap for {pos}.
They are nose to tail, {a} looking for a way by.
{a} has closed right up — this is going to happen.
Side by side out of the corner!

closing.t: {a} has found something, taking chunks out of {b}.

pulling_away.t: {drv} is edging clear at the front, {gap} the advantage.

fastlap.t: {t} for {drv}, and that is the lap to beat.

spin.t: That's a spin for {drv}, and places are going to go.

offtrack.t: Too much kerb, and {drv} is out of shape.
{drv} puts two wheels in the grass.

retire.t: Trouble for {drv}, and that is a retirement.

yellow.t: We have yellows out on track.

penalty.t: The stewards have had a look at {drv}, and there's a penalty.

lastlap.t: This is the final lap at {trk}!

final_laps.t: Into the closing stages, {laps} to run.
{laps} laps left, and this is where it counts.

win.t: And {drv} has won the Grand Prix!
{drv} takes the win — and it was never in doubt.
{drv} holds on to win it by {gap}!

milestone.t: Lap {lap}, and the order at the front is settled for now.

session.t: Welcome to {trk}, where the {series} field is about to go to work.
{trk} it is, and a full field ready to go.

analysis.t: That's the difference — he's carrying more speed through the corners.
Look at the traction on the exit. That's where the lap is.
He's been patient, and patience is what gets you past here.
Front tyres are going off. You can see it in the entry.
He's leaning on that left front, and it won't last.
That's a driver managing a problem rather than attacking.

analysis_era.t: These things were a handful. The wheel fought you everywhere.
Cars like this you aimed and hoped. There was nothing else to it.
By all accounts these were brutal to drive. No aids, no forgiveness.
Active suspension, traction control — this was the peak of the electronics before they banned the lot.
No power steering, no aids, and skinny tyres. Respect to anyone who raced these.
The hybrid systems make this a different sport to the one I knew.
Fuel allowance racing. It's as much a maths problem as a driving one.
On a superspeedway the draft does half the driving for you.

strategy.t: The undercut is live here — track position is everything.
He'll want to get out of traffic before he thinks about the stop.
Fuel is the call here. Save now, use it later.
One stop or two — that decision is being made right now on the pit wall.
No refuelling, so it's all about tyre life and nothing else.
Stage points change how you race this. You don't just drive to the flag.

verdict.t: He left him just enough room. Just.
Optimistic, that. He got away with it.
That's the move he had to make.

praise.t: That is a serious lap from {drv}.

criticism.t: That's a mistake, and it will cost him.
He asked too much of the front end there.

restart.t: Green flag, green flag! We are racing again!
